title: ENDEX

fields.resolution: ENDEX. It is now 11:00. The exercise ends here. Orchard Standpipe is out of service and under investigation, the first coliform results are due Monday, and the advisory, the sampling and the reports continue.
finalState: Orchard Standpipe is isolated and under investigation by Millbrook Police and the FBI.
Coliform results are due Monday morning; the chemical screen not before Wednesday.
The advisory, the two-hour hydrant sampling and the DDAGW reporting continue.
fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. Put down your phones and radios. Ten minutes, then the hot wash.
fields.hotWashMethod: 3-Up, 3-Down: three things that went well, three that did not
hotWashQuestions: When did the department first treat the overnight alarms as a possible entry, and what made it?
Which advisory did you choose, for which streets, and what was the deciding fact?
How did you reconcile the police scene with the need to isolate the standpipe?
What did you promise the public about how long the advisory would last, and was it realistic?
What should change about ZS-611, CAM-13 and the patrol route?

instructorNote: Collect ERP-1 and ERP-2 before the hot wash.

snapshot.title: Incident Closed — FBI Forensic Hold Maintained

fields.resolution: ENDEX. The FBI has confirmed the site remains under federal jurisdiction. All systems are under forensic hold. The precautionary boil-water advisory for Zone 2 remains in effect. The Control Room has verified that no unauthorized access occurred during recovery. Water quality remains stable. This concludes the exercise.
finalState: The Orchard Standpipe site remains secured under federal jurisdiction.
The precautionary boil-water advisory for Zone 2 remains in effect.
All SCADA and IT systems are under forensic hold and no restoration is authorized.
Water quality is stable; AIT-611 remains at 0.7 mg/L.
The FBI has not issued a formal release for system restoration.
fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. Put down your phones and radios. We will now begin the hot wash session.
fields.hotWashMethod: 3-Up, 3-Down: three things that went well, three things that broke
hotWashQuestions: What was the most effective action taken during the advisory phase?
How did the team manage conflicting priorities between public safety, technical integrity, and regulatory compliance?
What challenges arose in maintaining chain of custody during a high-visibility incident?
How could communication with external media have been improved under pressure?
What lessons can be drawn from the PLC-02 backup gap and its impact on recovery?
